CARDIA::confirmed::tak_statin.yaml.notes:
Free-text medication names mismapped as RxCUI within a statin-flag file; corrected to proper ATC classes: metoprolol=beta-blocker(ATC:C07AB), niacin=nicotinic acid deriv.(ATC:C10AD), gemfibrozil=fibrate(ATC:C10AB). Other RxCUI entries (mevacor, zocor, cholestid, pravachol, lopid, etc.) left untouched — curator-reviewed cross-study consistency pass, 2026-08-18.
C10AA = "HMG CoA reductase inhibitors," the specific statin subclass (atorvastatin, simvastatin, rosuvastatin, pravastatin, lovastatin, etc.) — this is distinct from and more precise than the broader C10A ("lipid modifying agents, plain"), which would also incorrectly sweep in non-statin drugs like niacin (C10AD) and gemfibrozil (C10AB) from your last question. Since a "taking statin" variable is asking specifically about statins, C10AA is the correct, tightest-fit code — not C10A
